description: Free, no key, nothing stored. Check an IBAN: shape, length (for the countries listed in the answer), ISO 13616 checksum, and for CH and LI whether it is a QR-IBAN and which reference it must go with. Formal only: no bank or register is asked, so it never says whose account it is.

iban.description: the IBAN, with or without spaces

name: iban_check
